t: Evo-Stik Sticks Like Sh*t is a high-performance, solvent-free grab adhesive, delivering a powerful and long-lasting bond. This white, 290ml synthetic polymer-based adhesive provides excellent vertical bonding strength and works on porous, non-porous, and even wet surfaces, including underwater. Professional tradespeople often use this for demanding tasks, such as securing panelling in bathrooms or mounting outdoor fixtures, as it is suitable for both interior and exterior applications. It forms a water-resistant and weather-resistant seal, tolerating temperatures from 5°C to 40°C. The low odour formulation is paintable with most non-alkyd resin-based paints, ensuring a clean and versatile finish.
